notes: cics-crucible ghost-tasks / gt-start-retrieve (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): START of background tasks: INTERVAL vs TIME (the six-hour rule), FROM data and RETRIEVE, ENDDATA, LENGERR, PROTECT vs an abending starter. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: interval-data
scenarios.why: START INTERVAL(0) FROM 20 bytes: one GT02 task retrieves them, then ENDDATA

scenarios.name: no-data
scenarios.why: START with no FROM: the first RETRIEVE is already ENDDATA

scenarios.name: time-six-hours
scenarios.why: at 10:00, TIME(103000) runs at 10:30, but TIME(093000) is in the past within six hours and runs at once, so the second START runs first

scenarios.name: retrieve-lengerr
scenarios.why: 30 bytes of FROM data into a 20-byte RETRIEVE area: truncated, LENGERR, LENGTH set to 30

scenarios.name: protect-abend
scenarios.why: the starter abends after two STARTs: the plain START still runs its task, the START PROTECT is discarded

scenarios.name: unknown-mode
scenarios.why: mode Z matches no WHEN (and there is no WHEN OTHER): no START is issued and no GT02 task runs, but the screen still says STARTS ISSUED
